decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already adds "directly on the NFT" to the FAQ's referral-code locations, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
Displaying the referral code directly on the NFT does not change which state transfers to a secondary buyer.
The referral code remains the permanent NFT mint number; the source change adds a display location without changing code identity or permanence.
Referral-code visibility on the NFT does not alter Small Block ticket issuance, eligibility, reset, weighting, or transfer rules.
The display location of an NFT's referral code does not change commission allocation when no referral code is entered.
Referral-code visibility does not change primary mint pricing, founder allocation, commissions, or prize-pool funding.
Adding direct NFT visibility does not change the existing optional confirmation email or its referral-code content.
The source change does not alter the direct referral commission's amount, trigger, recipient, timing, or payout mode.
Referral-code visibility on the NFT does not alter Big Block ticket issuance, eligibility, reset, weighting, transfer, or wallet rules.
The source change does not alter random ticket allocation when no referral code is used.
Displaying a referral code directly on an NFT does not change fiat mint wallet requirements or wallet requirements for commissions, tickets, or trading.
Referral-code visibility does not change Small Block prize amounts, activation, cadence, funding, qualifying sales, or winner eligibility.
